exec: pm.test('Round summary contract', () => { const rows = pm.response.json().periods; pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.at.most(10); rows.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.shopCount).to.eql(p.belowThresholdShopCount + p.atOrAboveThresholdShopCount); pm.expect(p.coinsAwarded).to.match(/^[0-9]+$/); pm.expect(p.created_at).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p).not.to.have.property('shop_coin_rates'); }); });

request.description: Returns only latest 10 round aggregates. Shop sales buckets are fixed at THB 10,000; coinsAwarded is gross actual ledger awards by award time, including later reversals. No shop names/details or 100-shop cap. Regression: raw ledger/round queries explicitly qualify the application schema, so a stale pooled search_path must not cause 42P01 or HTTP 500.

item.name: Government Coin Rules
item.description: Use government token. Set nonGovernmentToken from customer/seller login. 201 creates a pending rule; run 409 immediately after. No delete endpoint.

item.description: Use a GOVERNMENT token. Set shopId to a real PENDING shop before approving. Suspension requires a nonblank reason.

request.description: Advisory Coins estimate from frozen current round. Settlement recomputes at confirmation, including cutoff and concurrent purchases. NO_RATE/BELOW_MINIMUM => 0. Response includes decimal rewardAmount; help + reward + customer cash equals total.

Atomic money + purchase + Coins settlement. Frozen shop rate at confirmation, inclusive minimum; ever-awarded customer/shop gets repeat rate across months. Missing rate/below minimum yields 0. Main Quest grants once/month after settlement when the OPEN budget covers 100 THB. Existing rewards cover the remaining cash share; new grants apply to the next payment. Duplicate/concurrent loser 409; rollback all writes on error. Response includes decimal rewardAmount; help + reward + customer cash equals total.

item.name: Wallet history
item.description: Returns role-owned ledger items. Customer payment rows include the help/customer breakdown and coinsEarned only when a non-reversed Coin award exists.

exec: pm.test('Coin values are integers when present', () => { pm.response.json().filter(item => item.coinsEarned !== undefined).forEach(item => pm.expect(item.coinsEarned).to.be.a('number').and.satisfy(Number.isInteger)); });
